methodologyDescription: Pre-result Gate 13 acceptance accounting. The pinned runtime persists aggregate model usage, not per-request context-length/cache-write billing events, so model cost intentionally uses a conservative upper-bound treatment. Every PROMPT_TOKENS unit is charged at $10/1M: the maximum documented GPT-5.6 Sol standard input-side rate when the >272K long-context input rate ($8/1M) and 1.25x cache-write multiplier are considered. Every COMPLETION_TOKENS unit is charged at the documented long-context output rate of $30/1M. This can overstate real spend but cannot create a cost pass by assuming short-context or cache discounts that durable run evidence cannot independently reconstruct. Reasoning tokens are not charged a second time because the pinned OpenAI AI SDK exposes them as a subset of provider output_tokens. Self-hosted Steel/browser cost uses an explicit reference-infrastructure allocation equal to one AWS EC2 t3.2xlarge Linux On-Demand instance in us-east-1 at $0.3328/hour, billed proportionally from the server-derived run duration with no rounding. This is a reproducible conservative accounting allocation, not a claim that the browser host physically runs on AWS.

rates.label: GPT-5.6 Sol input tokens (maximum applicable standard-rate accounting)
rates.sourceDescription: OpenAI documents GPT-5.6 Sol standard short-context input at $4/1M and long-context (>272K input tokens) at $8/1M for the full request; cache writes are billed at 1.25x the uncached input rate. Because Gate 13 persists aggregate Stagehand prompt usage rather than per-request cache-write/context-threshold events, every prompt token is conservatively priced at $10/1M (1.25 x $8) to avoid understating measured delivery cost.

rates.label: GPT-5.6 Sol output tokens (long-context upper-bound accounting)
rates.sourceDescription: OpenAI documents GPT-5.6 Sol standard output at $20/1M for short-context requests and $30/1M when input exceeds 272K tokens. Gate 13 uses $30/1M for every completion token because durable usage is aggregate and cannot prove the threshold was never crossed. In the pinned AI SDK/OpenAI mapping outputTokens is provider output_tokens while reasoningTokens is a subset, so reasoning is not charged a second time.

rates.label: Self-hosted Steel reference compute allocation
rates.sourceDescription: Reference-equivalent self-hosted browser allocation using the documented AWS EC2 t3.2xlarge On-Demand hourly price of $0.3328 in us-east-1. Gate 13 execution remains self-hosted; this rate exists to make browser infrastructure cost reproducible and non-zero without pretending managed Steel Cloud pricing applies.
